purpose: Teach: ゲーテ/プリンセス/モナコ/ボリビア/シオン/有楽町/三鷹/ダーリン

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ゲーテの詩集をご愛読だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, apparently this customer reads Goethe's poetry collection.
lines.style: Soft, wondering tone. Speaking to herself as much as to Aoi. Gentle pause between clauses—noticing, processing, filing away something small and tender about a person.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、プリンセスのドキュメンタリーがお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: So this customer loves princess documentaries, Mei says.
lines.style: Quiet recognition in the voice. Not stating it as news, but confirming something already understood. A slight smile without showing teeth. Warm curiosity.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、モナコの新婚旅行のお話されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: The customer was telling you about their honeymoon in Monaco, wasn't it.
lines.style: Soft, almost wistful tone. Speaking gently, as if handling something delicate. A slight lilt at the end—not quite a question, more like inviting Aoi into the tenderness of the memory.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ボリビアのウユニ塩湖に行かれたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: They've been to the Uyuni Salt Flats in Bolivia, apparently.
lines.style: Quiet reverence for the distance and beauty. Speaking slowly, letting each place-name settle. A breath of admiration underneath—noticing how far someone has traveled, how much they've seen.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、シオンへの巡礼経験がおありだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: And they've made a pilgrimage to Zion, they said.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly awed register. The word 'pilgrimage' carries weight—this wasn't just a trip. A pause before the location, as if Mei is seeing it through the customer's eyes.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、有楽町のミニシアターに通われてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: They go to that small cinema in Yurakucho regularly, don't they.
lines.style: Recognition of dedication. Spoken with quiet appreciation for someone who shows up, who has a place they return to. A warmth that says: I see you've built a life of small, beautiful habits.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、三鷹ジブリ美術館がお気に入りだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: The Ghibli Museum in Mitaka is a favorite of theirs.
lines.style: Soft, almost nostalgic. As if Mei is picturing the museum—the care in it, the tenderness. A slight exhale of recognition that says: yes, that makes sense for someone like them.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、配偶者をダーリンと呼んでらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And they call their spouse 'darling,' don't they.
lines.style: Voice turns tender and intimate. The smallest smile. Not mocking the sweetness—honoring it. A quiet moment of seeing someone's love for another person and letting it matter.
